strlen = len(input_bytes)

# Step 2: Hash computation
rdx = strlen * 0xf4243
rdx = (rdx + 0x17) & 0xffffffffffffffff
rdx = (rdx * rdx) & 0xffffffffffffffff
rdx = (rdx + 7) & 0xffffffffffffffff
rdx = (rdx * 0x86bca1af286bca1b) & 0xffffffffffffffff
rdx = (rdx + 0x1af286bca1af286b) & 0xffffffffffffffff

threshold = 0xd79435e50d79435

print(f"Threshold: 0x{threshold:x}")

# cmp rax, rdx where rax = threshold, rdx = hash
# jae taken if threshold >= hash

    print("Path: strcmp (jae taken)")

    edx = 0xffffff8f
    all_match = True
    
    for i in range(25):

        expected = target_bytes[i]

            all_match = False
            break
        edx = (edx + input_bytes[i]) & 0xffffffff
    
    if all_match:
        print("XOR check: PASS - All 25 characters match!")
        print("Result: Correct.")
else:
